name: tenants_change_pay_band
description: Change a pay band, by pay_band_id from tenants_pay_bands. Currency, period and minimum, midpoint and maximum are required, as the band reads afterwards. Give any of role_family_id, role_id, level_ordinal or level_id to change what it matches on: those given replace the whole matcher. Give location to move it, blank for any location. The band keeps its position; tenants_reorder_pay_bands moves it. Every plan priced from it reprices. A band matches on whichever of role_family_id, role_id (both from frameworks_get), level_ordinal (the level number, 1 for a role's first level) and location it is given; one left out matches anything. Give a role or a role family, not both. level_id instead matches one framework level, follows it when the framework renumbers it, and keeps pricing its seats once it leaves. The bands form an ordered list: of the bands that match a seat, the last has the last word. A new band lands after the last band no narrower than it; tenants_reorder_pay_bands moves it. Figures are decimal strings with at most two decimal places, such as "120000". Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
